title: How to organize the clothing closet | Kids Bedroom
description:
Holds the clothes that fit right now, at a height the child can dress themselves from.

This is the Clothing Closet in the Kids Bedroom. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Rod lowered so the child reaches a hanger without a stool. Every hanger the same type, all facing the same way. Shirts together, dresses together, jackets together, with a hand's width gap between groups so a row can actually be read. Shoes in pairs on the floor rack, backpack on its own low hook, next size up in one labelled box on the top shelf.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Pull anything that is the wrong size.
Straighten: Lower the rod. It is one bracket move, and it changes who is capable of using this closet.
Shine: Empty the closet floor completely, vacuum it, and wipe the rod down where hangers have left a grey line.

Standardize: One hanger style throughout, and the next size box labelled in numbers big enough to read from the doorway.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Only clothes that fit today hang on the rod, grouped by type, on one hanger style, at a height the child reaches unaided.
